decisions.summary: the no-new-kink row E0: claim cites 0081's zigzag and doubling-back bullets
decisions.why: joints.py refuses len(kink_spans(new)) > len(kink_spans(old)); kink_spans is the 0081 140-degree hairpin and two-50-degree-turns-in-40-ft zigzag rules; the page says a lane does not zigzag and never doubles back. The page already says what the code does.

decisions.summary: the pulled lane's clearance row E0, claim labeled CONVENTION citing 0081 'may come right up to the buildings'
decisions.why: 0081: a pulled lane 'runs straight ... wherever it can keep its usual clearance from fences and buildings. It may come right up to the buildings when the straightened line stays within 6 ft' - the exception is for BUILDINGS; fences keep the usual clearance. The code's touch test (_clear_touch with gap max(4, w/2+2)) applies to every wall and hard polygon: walls = the whole homestead fabric (houses, threshing_yards, gardens, web.py:627, fabric.py:161-171) and hard_built includes _solid, so a pulled lane may come 4-4.5 ft from a garden fence where _clear_link's usual is 7 ft (0246's figure). The page does not say what the code does, so FR-003's E0 does not hold; a claim reading 'building or wall' beside a page that licenses buildings only is not an honest label. Leaving it E0 leaves an implementation departure unfixed - less than asked. Re-tier (E2: the touch exception limited to buildings, fences/yards keeping the usual clearance), or take FR-004's exception path if measurement shows it cannot.

decisions.summary: docs/buildings.md main gate passage width tiered E3 and left for its place in the run
decisions.why: 0093 measures the yakuimon 'across their frontage' (1.8-2.6 m) and its drawing page draws 6-8.5 ft as 'the frontage'; docs/buildings.md:126 makes 6-8.5 ft the passage BETWEEN posts drawn outside it, as does compound.py:670's 8 ft passage. The fix crosses the procedure, the engine and hand sheets - FR-003's E3 ('a change across modules, or a hand-drawn sheet redrawn'). Ranked (scope mode-a, wave open), so FR-006's easiest-first order takes it later; not dropped.
